cues.phrase: Risk is 50% lower / Odds are 50% lower / Risk is 50 percentage points lower
cues.why: The key combines the majority components: risk appears in two options and 50% lower appears in two. It can be selected by convergence. The task also names risk, making the odds option a category mismatch before any conversion.

fairness: The option set permits a wording strategy despite a single defensible general interpretation.
suggestions: Use parallel risk statements that differ in direction or magnitude, for example "Risk is 50% lower", "Risk is 50% higher", and "Risk is unchanged". Keep the one-line RR and the relative-reduction explanation; do not add a clinical decision.
